6 warnings from the pg database driver: "client.query() while already executing … removed in pg@9". First theory – two queries started together inside a transaction in memberPoints – was tested and disproved (0 warnings; Prisma queues them), so that change was undone. Proven cause: Prisma 7's adapter loads several relations (4 includes) in parallel inside a transaction (1 warning; with 1 include or outside a transaction: 0). Results stay correct; pg is locked to 8.23.1, so version 9 cannot arrive unnoticed.
